title: Logarithm-bound vector coordinate
statement: For every exponential breadth-first search state $st$, the coordinate at index $1$ of its counter vector is the logarithm-bound counter $Lg$.
hypotheses_covered: $st$ is an exponential breadth-first search state
replaced:
For every state $S$ of the exponential breadth-first search procedure, the
logarithm-bound coordinate of its 17-entry register vector is $S.Lg$.
